title: Hyperextension Injury
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Ask whether the knee went backwards or past straight, and whether they saw or felt it happen.
Ask whether they were kicking, landing, or stepping into something unexpected.
Ask whether the knee felt like it came apart, and whether it swelled immediately.
Ask about any numbness, tingling or weakness in the foot afterwards, because a nerve symptom raises the energy of the injury considerably.
Ask whether they can now fully straighten the knee and whether it feels like it goes back too far.
